evidence_excerpt: JMT Trucking is located in Des Moines, Iowa, and Ames, Iowa, with the ability to serve the entire Central Iowa area. Dump Truck Services for Central Iowa. Aggregate delivery and dirt hauling for road construction, infrastructure improvements, and large-scale public works projects. Corporate Headquarters: 5550 NE 22nd Ave. | Des Moines, IA 50313. Dispatch: 515.262.3102.
notes: jmttrucking.com resolves to the JMT Trucking pages at rasmussengroup.com/jmttrucking/. Headquarters street is 5550 NE 22nd Ave, Des Moines, IA 50313; mailing address on the same page is PO Box 3334, Des Moines, IA 50316. Trade pages describe dump-truck aggregate delivery and dirt hauling for residential, commercial, heavy highway, and agricultural work. The about page calls it a family-run business since 1994. Dispatch phone 515.262.3102 is published; the contact page has a form and no published email. Leadership lists Kenny Bauman, Vice President; Matt Triggs, Executive Vice President; Sammi Wangsness, Operations Manager; Jeff Vroom, Sales Manager; Chris Devine, Dispatch Department Manager. Rasmussen Group leadership lists executive officers and describes the group as the management company for operating businesses including JMT Trucking. Those titles are not owner, founder, co-founder, or managing member.
